preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of nodes k to inspect must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each time a_i spent on building the i-th ball must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum grade Jacob can achieve, which is the minimum a_i among the first k nodes in the best DFS traversal.
